data.exact_reserve_text: The following table presents the comparison of actual claims incurred to previous estimates. No net table is produced as all of Syndicate 3500's business is fully reinsured.

prior_year_events.impact_description: remaining underlying reserves estimated to be GBP 65 million gross and GBP 29 million net, before consideration of reinsurance from Syndicate 3500's affiliated reinsurer. The gross reserves, which remain subject to uncertainty depending on the outcome of court actions in the US, are principally on the aviation classes and have been assessed on a case-by-case 'best estimate' basis.

named_events.loss_description: remaining underlying reserves of Syndicate 3500 in connection with the events of 11th September are estimated to be GBP 65 million gross and GBP 29 million net, before consideration of reinsurance from Syndicate 3500's affiliated reinsurer. The gross reserves, which remain subject to uncertainty depending on the outcome of court actions in the US, are principally on the aviation classes and have been assessed on a case-by-case 'best estimate' basis.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3500 experienced a net release of GBP 4.54 million in prior year reserves, primarily driven by favorable development on the 2008 and 2010 underwriting years, partially offset by adverse development on the 2007 underwriting year. The syndicate is fully reinsured, minimizing net uncertainty.
raw_causal_phrases: comparison of actual claims incurred to previous estimates

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development table on page 8, comparing the 2015 estimate to the 2014 estimate for underwriting years 2007, 2008, and 2010. Due to the table's structure and blank cells, not all prior underwriting years could be included in the calculation. Gross premium mix percentages are based on absolute values.
